question:
Find the value of x in the given figure where TF ( tangent on point T) = 15 cm, FB = 2x + 3 cm, FA = 9 cm.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/969476d2826aacc020673e1b82c87a3255d473fb364231841f7f2dea8284842b.png]
solution:
Given:- 

TF = 15 cm, FB = 2x + 3 cm and FA = 9 cm

Concept used:-

According to the tangent theorem,

TF2 = FA × FB

Calculation:-

TF2 = FA × FB

⇒ 225 = 9 × (2x + 3) 

⇒ (2x + 3) = 25

⇒ x = 11cm 

∴ The required result will be 11.
